decisions.rule: Record freezes by issuer, asset and chain. A Circle USDC freeze on Ethereum is not an XRPL freeze. Preserve individual issuer amounts; do not assign a share of an aggregate freeze basket to Ripple without transaction-level evidence.
Native XRP has no issuer-level blacklist. Keep this as a custody/recoverability distinction, not a bullish or bearish price feature.
A COIN share-price move is not a measure of XRP migration or Coinbase custody inflows. Require actual custody flows and venue volume data before admitting a Coinbase-beneficiary hypothesis.
Do not transfer BTC/ETH Binance spread multipliers to XRP. Measure XRP spread/depth separately and align transfer availability with order-book observations.
